description: Library size snapshot: counts for tracks/albums/shows/episodes/audiobooks/playlists via limit=1 reads — no item paging. The total covers library saves only: playlists are owned and followed collections, so their count is reported alongside the library rows and excluded from the total. A collection that could not be read (rate limited, gated, or erroring) is reported as unreadable with its reason and left out of the total — it is never reported as 0. One attempt per collection: a rate limit is surfaced, not retried. Quota: 6 GETs.

response_format.description: 'concise' = human prose, 'detailed' = more fields in prose, 'json' = raw API object

name: get_saved_counts
